jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence
jobs.description:
A position as Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence is available at the Department of Management, Society and Communication for appointment on 01 January 2027.

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS, part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with engaged students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

MSC’s research and teaching addresses the dynamic relations between business and society and the responsible management thereof. To this end, MSC mobilises a wide range of knowledge within management and business disciplines as well as the broader social and human sciences, organized in three interconnected research environments: CBS Sustainability; Centre for Business and Development Studies; the Communication, Organisation and Governance Research Cluster.

The position includes 

• 
Planning and conducting teaching on responsible business governance and corporate responsibility due diligence, with a particular focus on risk management, reporting and finance between sustainability expectations and compliance. The part-time lecturer is expected to have solid knowledge of sustainability (risk-based) due diligence, international governance frameworks on responsible business conduct, EU law and policy on corporate sustainability, demands on companies, social expectations of responsible business conduct, and business uptake, responses and challenges in the interface of management and growing public regulation of responsible business and corporate sustainability.

• 
Online teaching—blended learning

• 
Student supervision

• 
Preparing teaching materials and exam questions

• 
Conducting exams and other evaluations

Qualifications

To fill this position, you have a master’s degree and:

• 
High-level practical experience at a high level, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or

• 
Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).

• 
A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits based on their relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.

• 
Employment as part-time lecturer presupposes that teaching qualifications are included in the assessment of applicants for an external professor.

Other skills

• 
In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses.

• 
Good interpersonal and collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment

• 
Teaching is mainly done in English. Proficiency in Danish will be helpful as some supervision opportunities may be in Danish. The conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment

Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.

You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information

If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Professor Karin Buhmann, email kbu.msc@cbs.dk.

Your application

To apply, click on the link “Apply online”, fill out the application form and attach the following documentation:

• 
Letter of motivation

• 
CV

• 
Diploma(s)

• 
Teaching Portfolio

• 
Publication list, if relevant for the position

Additional information about CBS and the department is available at www.cbs.dk.

Application due 11/3/2026

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Finance Manager who will be instrumental in establishing and developing a robust, scalable finance function that enables Quantum Foundry Copenhagen to achieve its strategic ambitions.

Do you want to be part of pioneering quantum computing in the heart of Copenhagen? Quantum Foundry Copenhagen, owned by the Novo Nordisk Foundation (NNF), is dedicated to developing next-generation quantum computing processor technologies.

Our mission is to establish a foundry capable of manufacturing quantum processor units (QPUs) using novel methods that meet the extreme requirements for purity, precision, and scalability required to unlock the full potential of quantum computing. As we continue to grow, you will play a key role in building the financial foundation that supports our journey from pioneering research and development to world-class manufacturing capabilities.

Our company is part of a vibrant and growing Danish quantum ecosystem, and we collaborate closely with world-leading researchers at Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP www.nqcp.ku.dk) based at the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen. The NQCP programme is designed to facilitate and drive research and innovations at multiple levels – from developing materials and quantum processor technologies through solutions for the quantum-classical control and readout interface, and all the way to quantum algorithms and applications.

In close collaboration with NQCP and international partners, we aim to pioneer chip-based fabrication and packaging methods for state-of-the-art quantum processors.

Join our team

As our Finance Manager, you will help build and run a robust, scalable finance function for Quantum Foundry Copenhagen. This is a hands-on role combining financial operations, reporting and business partnering with the development of processes, controls and systems.

You will work closely with management, budget owners and external finance partners, providing reliable financial insight and helping the organisation make informed decisions.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Managing the monthly close and preparing timely management reporting

• Leading budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning and variance analysis

• Overseeing accounting operations, payments, expenses, VAT and payroll-related finance activities

• Developing financial processes, internal controls and approval flows

• Improving the use of Business Central and related finance systems

• Supporting budget owners with cost management, procurement and investment cases

• Coordinating auditors, accountants, tax advisers and other external partners

• Contributing financial insight to management and board materials

Professional and Personal Qualifications

You are structured, accurate and action-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy working hands-on, improving how things are done and building finance capabilities in a fast-growing organisation.

Your qualifications and experience may include:

• A relevant degree in finance, accounting, economics or business administration

• At least five years of relevant finance, accounting or controlling experience

• Strong knowledge of management reporting, budgeting and financial control

• Experience from a growing, project-based, R&D, manufacturing or technology organisation

• Experience with Business Central or a similar ERP system is required

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills

• Professional fluency in English; Danish is an advantage

We offer

Joining Quantum Foundry Copenhagen, you will become part of a collaborative, hands-on and results-oriented Operations Team responsible for supporting the organization's day-to-day business and long-term effectiveness. The Operations team brings together expertise across Procurement, People & Organization, Office Management, and Data IT &v Management, working closely to ensure strong processes, operational excellence, and sound business support. We value efficiency and teamwork, and foster an environment where colleagues actively contribute to the shared mission.

Benefits include generous vacation time, health insurance, a good pension scheme, and a chance to contribute to a dynamic and innovative team.

The application process: For more information, please contact – Marie Mathiesen, COO (mmt@qfcph.com).

To apply, please click the Apply button and submit your:

• Curriculum vitae, including a short cover letter

• Diplomas (Bachelors, Master’s Degree or equivalent)

We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as possible and no later than October 28 2026.

Employment is contingent upon security clearance.

jobs.occupation: Head Chef
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Head Chef with a passion for food, culture, and community to join our team at Hobo Copenhagen. Opening in February 2027, you will shape our culinary identity and set the scene from day one. Are you a hands-on kitchen leader who thrives in dynamic environments, loves working alongside your team, and brings fresh, creative energy to work? Someone who crafts vibrant food experiences that bring people together? Then keep reading.

About Hobo

Yes, Hobo Copenhagen will be a lifestyle hotel. But more importantly, it will be a community. A place where we live, work, create, learn, and have fun together. A space for the curious, the social, and the young at heart. Since day one, with our sister hotels in Stockholm, Helsinki and Oslo, Hobo has been about more than rooms, it's about experiences, culture, and connection. With our vibrant restaurant, bar, event spaces, and local footprints, we will be constantly evolving. Always in beta. Always moving. We live by three core values: professional, passionate, and playful — and we expect the same from you.

About the role

As our Head Chef, you will lead all kitchen operations across Hobo Copenhagen, taking overall responsibility for our restaurant, all-day café, cocktail bar food, breakfast and conference. In a typical week, your time will center around dynamic, fully on-site shifts across all days of the week, with a heavy emphasis on leading service during peak evening and weekend periods (typically starting around 11:00 and running through to midnight). You’ll spend your days working directly on the pass alongside your team, mentoring chef’s, managing stewarding routines, managing the schedule, and handling ordering and inventory control. You’ll also balance daily service with weekly menu development sessions alongside the Bar & Restaurant Manager and F&B Manager, testing new seasonal ideas and sharing concepts that fit Hobo’s playful culture. Ultimately, you are here to build a cohesive, motivated kitchen team, run an efficient and food-safe kitchen, and establish a standout culinary reputation for Hobo Copenhagen while consistently meeting food cost and sustainability targets.

What you'll do

• 
Lead daily kitchen service with a strong hands-on presence, ensuring high culinary standards, consistency, and timely delivery across all outlets.

• 
Create and update seasonal menus, sharing dishes, and creative food initiatives that align with Hobo’s brand identity.

• 
Onboard, train, and coach kitchen colleagues and stewarding staff, fostering a respectful, positive, and supportive kitchen culture.

• 
Oversee staff scheduling, handle sick calls, manage ordering, stock rotation, and food cost controls to minimize waste.

• 
Maintain strict food safety and allergen standards, while supporting Hobo's sustainability practices such as waste sorting and resource management.

• 
Coordinate closely with the Bar & Restaurant Manager and F&B Manager to ensure smooth preparation, timing, and service flow.

Desired qualifications

• 
Relevant culinary training and proven experience leading a professional kitchen team.

• 
Strong culinary expertise with a background in developing seasonal menus, sharing concepts, and modern dining experiences.

• 
Solid grasp of kitchen administration, including staff scheduling, purchasing, stock management, and food cost control.

• 
In-depth knowledge of food safety, allergen management, and kitchen hygiene systems (e.g., e-smiley).

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A people-focused leader who excels at communication, calm problem-solving under pressure, and team mentorship.

Bonus if you

• 
Are fluent or proficient in Danish or any of the Scandinavian languages.

• 
Have experience launching pop-up culinary concepts, chef collaborations, or high-volume lifestyle restaurant openings.

• 
Have prior experience using modern kitchen management and digital staff scheduling tools.

What we offer

As a full-time employee at Hobo Copenhagen, you are also a member of Strawberry and Nordic Hotels & Resorts, which gives you a lot of benefits.

• 
A creative playground where your ideas actually come to life.

• 
The chance to shape one of Copenhagen's most dynamic new hotel brands.

• 
A role where no two days are the same and you can leave your personal imprint.

• 
Four free nights at a hotel of your choice in our hotel chain per year.

• 
Staff prices in all chain restaurants and hotels (Strawberry).

Employment type

This position is a full-time position, the lead for the kitchen team and reporting to the F&B Manager, Gobo Hansen. Flexibility in scheduling is required, including availability for evenings and weekends depending on the activity.

Are we a match?

If you meet these requirements and are ready to create, connect, and curate the food scene at Hobo Copenhagen from the inside out, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your CV. To help us get to know you, attach a cover letter, or even better, a short video telling us about yourself and your absolute favorite, hidden spot in Copenhagen.

Application deadline: 1st of November 2026.

Start date: January 2027.

For questions regarding the role, please reach out to F&B Manager, Gobo Hansen, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk. Please note that no applications will be accepted via email.

We review candidates continuously, so don't wait too long to apply!

Are you a visible, vibrant leader with strong bar and restaurant expertise who loves making guests feel welcome? Bonus if you

What we offer

A creative playground where your ideas actually come to life.

The chance to shape one of Copenhagen's most dynamic new hotel brands.

• 
A role where no two days are the same and you can leave your personal imprint.

Four free nights at a hotel of your choice in our hotel chain per year.

Employment type

This position is a full-time position, part of the F&B management team and reporting to the F&B Manager, Gobo Hansen. Flexibility in scheduling is required, including availability for evenings and weekends depending on the activity.

Are we a match?

If you meet these requirements and are ready to create, connect, and curate the F&B scene at Hobo Copenhagen from the inside out, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your CV. To help us get to know you, attach a cover letter, or even better, a short video telling us about yourself and your absolute favorite, hidden spot in Copenhagen.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our High-Performance Development team in Denmark in a role focused on Improving and maintaining our power plant control software solution that is deployed to SGRE wind farms all over the world.

Your day may start with investigating a support case, perform remote troubleshooting and conduct detailed event analysis of power plant operations to identify and resolve software or configuration issues.

Afterwards you would resume to your regular software development task in the agile development team, with daily scrums and develop high-quality code including unit- and automated integration tests to ensure correct behavior.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop/maintain. C# .NET based platform that supports real-time control

• Design and develop data services that serve, process and store large data amounts within wind farms.

• Relentless focus on cyber solutions.

• Develop configuration validation, monitoring and tooling

• Clarify and mature requirements

• Contribute to planning

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, preferably combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• C# and automated testing.  Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C++ and Python language experience is appreciated as well.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

You will join the Development team in Denmark, where Software Developer/Engineers collaborate to constantly improve wind farm control and power plant solutions.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. Who is Siemens Energy?

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Work-life balance: Flexible working time

• Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

jobs.occupation: KPMG TechAcademy 2027
jobs.description:
Solve business challenges with AI alongside industry-leading experts

KPMG TechAcademy is an intensive, hands-on program for motivated students who want to explore how technology, AI and consulting come together to solve real business challenges

Are you curious about:

• How AI can solve real business challenges?

• How consultants turn complex problems into actionable solutions?

• How to build and test AI-powered prototypes?

• How technology creates measurable business value?

• How the next generation of consulting is being shaped by AI?

If so, TechAcademy is the place for you! Join us to explore:

• The latest technologies used to solve real-world business and client challenges.

• Deep insights into new technologies and their impact

• What it’s like to work at KPMG NewTech and in Management Consulting.

• The future of work and the skills you’ll need to thrive.

• How to move from best practices to NewPractice: shifting from human scaling to tech scaling.

Why join TechAcademy?

Throughout TechAcademy, you will work in a team on one shared, client-relevant case. You will receive business context, stakeholder perspectives, data and constraints, but you will not be given the answer.

It will be up to your team to identify the most valuable opportunity, select a solution worth pursuing and demonstrate why it can create an impact.

Along the way, you will receive inspiration, practical tools and sparring from KPMG NewTech professionals with experience in technology, AI and consulting. The program is designed to give you a realistic view of how we work with complex client challenges at KPMG NewTech.

Who are we looking for?

• TechAcademy is open to all university students (bachelor’s or master’s level), regardless of your field of study.

• You don’t need a tech background, what matters most is your interest in learning and genuine curiosity about technology. Skills can be taught, but interest in learning is key

• Permanent residency in Copenhagen is required.

Practical information:

Format: Four evening sessions from 16:00-21:00

Location: KPMG, Copenhagen

Participation: Attendance and active participation are expected across all four sessions

Included: Dinner, refreshments, materials and access to relevant tools during the sessions

Session dates

• Session 1: 4 March, 2027

• Session 2: 18 March, 2027

• Session 3: 8 April, 2027

• Session 4 and finale: 23 April, 2027

Application:

To apply, submit a motivational letter or video as well as CV and grade transcripts no later than 30 November, 2026.

In your motivational letter, you should answer the following questions, max 1 page:

• Why would you like to participate in KPMG TechAcademy?

• What do you hope to learn or gain from the program?

• What makes you a strong candidate for TechAcademy?

You may draw on experiences from your studies, work, volunteering, student organisations or personal projects.

We expect to provide feedback to all applicants during December 2026 or January 2027.

We look forward to receiving your application!

KPMG is a global network of professional services firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 142 countries and have over 275,000 people working in member firms around the world. We work closely with a broad range of clients, such as business corporations, governments and public sector agencies and not-for-profit organisations. We support them in mitigating risks and exploiting business opportunities.

KPMG in Denmark is one of the fastest-growing professional services companies in Denmark, achieving 1.6 billion DKK in revenue in FY25. Together, over 600 employees and partners help our customers ignite their potential. By combining our global vision with comprehensive local knowledge, we create long-term value with a responsible use of technology with a human touch.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager in Regional Support Nordic
jobs.description:
Vattenfall is now looking for the right person to fill the position as Project Manager in Regional Support Nordic, responsible for providing standardized site support to our the wind farms in the Nordic Region, from the O&M location in Esbjerg.

The Project Manager will be responsible for documentation and one point of contact on all internal centrally driven project activities coming from support functions e.g., engineering, technical support etc. towards sites. The Project Manager must ensure that they are effectively integrated, delivery is coordinated, and execution is supported on site, focusing on the safe and efficient delivery of offshore operations.

The Project Manager can be responsible for:

• Regional project activities, i.e. WTG planned maintenance and minor corrective activities.

• Responsible to realize portfolio synergies.

• Project execution and third parties, with special focus on the safe and efficient delivery on offshore operations.

• On site project management, ensuring that centrally driven projects are effectively integrated on site.

• Deliver service packages to site coordinating i.e. planning, spare parts and documentation.

• Manage key interfaces between site and Central Support functions

• Manage and create the site-specific documentation (RAMS etc.)

• Collate and review service reports from contractors/third-parties on site.

• Liaise with contractors/third parties to ensure that the requested skills/training/competences etc. are understood prior to their arrival on site.

Qualifications

• A degree in engineering (marine, electrical, mechanical etc.) or experienced wind turbine technician or other technical education

• Experience within Project Management, Document Creation, Stakeholder Management etc.

• Preferable have relevant work experience e.g. from the wind business, power generation or Operation & Maintenance in a related field

• Strong drive and business mind set

• Good communication, cooperation and organizational skills

• Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken

Additional Information

You will work in an open, agile and modern environment and collaborating with great colleagues who support each other. We are offering you a work environment with diverse, international and inspiring colleagues where we focus on resilience, knowing that this is a key element for your wellbeing. We support the reconciliation between work and private life with flexible working conditions supported by a smart travel policy.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

How to apply

We welcome your application in English, including CV and cover letter via the link, no later than the 30th of October 2026.

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact Manager of Regional Support Nordic, Morten Geil, morten.geil@vattenfall.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Energy is our contribution to quality of life – day after day. With around 21,000 colleagues Vattenfall provides comprehensive electricity and heating offerings to several million customers in northern Europe. For the work ahead we need people who are fully dedicated to our customers and to a sustainable society – people like you.

Company Description

jobs.occupation: Jentas is looking for a technically proficient part-time graphic designer with AI experience
jobs.description:
The publishing house Jentas is looking for a part-time graphic designer with a razor-sharp eye for good visual craftsmanship and experience working purposefully and constructively with AI.

Would you like to work for a dynamic and innovative publisher? Do you know what a cover that grabs the reader’s attention looks like? Are you detail-oriented when creating graphic products but able to zoom out to the bigger picture when prioritising your tasks? Do you have experience using AI to work more efficiently and deliver even better results? And are you ready for new challenges and not afraid to find alternative solutions?

Then you may be the person we are looking for.

Jentas (part of Bonnier Books) is a small publishing house specialising in the translation of crime, thriller and feel-good fiction from English into a wide range of other European languages, including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Finnish, Polish, German and more. With us, you will be part of a close-knit team of graphic designers, publishers and project developers, and your tasks will centre on graphic production and on developing and improving graphic workflows.

This will involve:

• Designing covers for Jentas’ many new releases, primarily within the thriller, crime and feel-good genres

• Typesetting and, where relevant, entering corrections from proofreaders etc.

• Ongoing optimisation of graphic workflows, including through the use of AI and new technical tools to strengthen efficiency and quality

• Ad hoc graphical tasks of a smaller nature, e.g. related to the publisher’s social media presence, attendance at book fairs and similar

We therefore envision that you…

• Are an Adobe suite power user and are familiar with other relevant graphic design programs

• Have experience with and an interest in new AI tools, both for use in the graphic work itself and for optimising graphic workflows

• Have a strong eye for composition, aesthetics, typography, contrast, imagery and more

• Are structured and detail-oriented, and thrive when working independently

• Can plan and prioritise your tasks and are able to both set and meet deadlines

• Are good at collaborating internally in a small team where cooperation, sparring and shared development are crucial, and are also able to communicate precisely and smoothly with external partners

• Feel comfortable communicating both verbally and in writing in English and, ideally, another European language, which may be Danish but does not have to be

We also expect that you…

• Ideally have at least 1–2 years of experience as a graphic designer

• Have experience with print production, preferably for book publishing

We expect to interview candidates on an ongoing basis and would like to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 10 November. The position will be filled once the right candidate has been found.

The position is a part-time role of 25 hours per week, based at the publisher’s address. Start date preferably 11 January or as soon as possible hereafter.

Workplace: Smallegade 46B, 1st floor, 2000 Frederiksberg

Please send your application, CV, portfolio and any references by email, with the subject line “Grafiker”, to Chief Graphic Designer Holger Lund at holger@jentas.dk. Feel free to write your application in Danish or English, whichever suits you best. See also www.jentas.dk for a Danish version of this job post.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Director, Creative Operations
jobs.description:
Location: Copenhagen

We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

Creative Operations & Project Management

• 
Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• 
Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• 
Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• 
Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

• 
Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• 
Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• 
Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• 
Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

Agency & Vendor Management

• 
Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• 
Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• 
Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

Change Management & Transformation

• 
Lead change initiatives that enable successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.

• 
Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

• 
Influence stakeholders across the business to deliver sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

Budget & Resource Management

• 
Own budget planning for Creative Operations systems, technology investments, and operational needs in partnership with the Head of Production.

• 
Forecast and optimize resource allocation across internal teams and external partners.

• 
Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

Qualifications & Experience

• 
Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• 
Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• 
Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

• 
Experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI-enabled or automation solutions within creative, marketing, or operational environments.

• 
Experience leading RFPs, developing business cases, and delivering technology implementations in partnership with Digital & Technology teams.

• 
Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, content production, localization, and asset management.

• 
Demonstrated success managing agency and vendor partnerships, including localization, customization, and technology providers.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills.

• 
Proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across complex organizations.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

• 
Experience with budget planning, financial management, and investment prioritization.

• 
Passion for leveraging technology, automation, and innovation to improve creative effectiveness and operational excellence.

Reports to: VP Brand Creative

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Process consultant - Viby DK
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn complex procurement processes into practical digital solutions that create measurable business value? And are you motivated by working at the intersection of business, process improvement and technology?

“As our new Senior Business Process Consultant, you will connect business needs with digital opportunities within Procurement. You will join our Digital S2C Excellence team, part of Procurement Data and Digital Excellence, where you will work across Procurement, business functions and digital teams to improve the way we work and help translate business requirements into effective processes and solutions”, says Anette Falk Bøgebjerg, Head of Data & Digital Excellence for Procurement.

How you will make an impact

Reporting to the Head of Digital S2C Excellence, you will play an important role in developing and improving Arla's source-to-contract and procure-to-pay processes. Combining process knowledge, data and stakeholder insights, you will identify improvement opportunities, help design solutions and support their implementation across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Facilitate business process improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to define and document clear objectives, requirements and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyse process and performance data to identify trends, challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.

• Design process and digital solutions that support business priorities, working closely with Digital Business Consultants and relevant Procurement and business teams.

• Maintain high-quality process documentation, define and monitor performance metrics and ensure alignment with Arla's process framework.

• Support change management, stakeholder training and the successful handover of improved processes to operational teams.

What will make you successful

For this role, we are looking for someone with 2-3 years of Procurement category knowledge and preferably an understanding of Source-to-Pay processes.

You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field, are interested in how digital solutions and data can enable better ways of working, and you are comfortable turning business requirements and analysis into practical recommendations. LEAN background would be an advantage.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you bring solid knowledge about source to contract processes and are motivated to develop your expertise further in a complex, international Procurement environment.

To succeed in the role, you

• Approach complex challenges with curiosity and use data and critical thinking to understand problems and identify practical solutions.

• Build constructive relationships across functions and can communicate requirements and ideas clearly to different stakeholders.

• Take ownership of your work while actively collaborating with others to create improvements that work in practice.

As Arla is an international organisation, professional proficiency in English is required.

What do we offer?

You will become part of Digital S2C Excellence within Procurement Data and Digital Excellence in Aarhus. The team has adopted agile ways of working and you will work in an  environment where business expertise, data and digital capabilities come together to improve the way Procurement operates.

The position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in business process management and digital transformation while working with colleagues across functions and geographies. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements while developing your professional capabilities within a global organisation.

We are committed to professional development and creating a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other in delivering results. You will join a global, farmer-owned dairy cooperative working to create value for our customers, our farmer owners and the wider world.

Would you like to join us?

If you would like to combine your category experience and business process skills with data and digital solutions to help shape the future of Procurement at Arla, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Head of Data & Digital Excellence, Anette Falk Bøgebjerg at anefb@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.
